rule: IF 5 <= 1st-sem units approved < 6 AND 5 <= 1st-sem units enrolled < 6 THEN Graduate
IF 3 <= 1st-sem units approved < 5 AND 6 <= 1st-sem units enrolled < 7 THEN Dropout
IF 3 <= 1st-sem units approved < 5 AND 5 <= 1st-sem units enrolled < 6 THEN Enrolled
IF 3 <= 1st-sem units approved < 5 AND 1st-sem units enrolled >= 7 THEN Dropout
IF 5 <= 1st-sem units approved < 6 AND 1st-sem units enrolled >= 7 THEN Enrolled
